title: Job runner results and lock contention don't reach the logs
current: dispatchDueJobs returns a map of results (complete, retry, exhausted, not_due), but dispatchScheduledJobs and dispatchOnboardingJob discard it. A worker whose lock is busy returns not_due with no log. Only exhaustion, budget deferral and thrown errors are logged.
location: src/server/jobs/scheduled.ts:15 (result discarded); src/server/jobs/runner.ts:194 (lock busy → not_due); src/server/jobs/onboarding.ts:101
evidence: A job retrying every minute (status retry) is visible only once it's exhausted. With the cron run summary from #255, the parent action shows as 'ran' with no detail.
required: Feed the per-job results into the cron run summary (for example permission_gated_jobs=acted(app_repair:complete,source_deletion:retry)), and log busy worker locks with a reason.

criticality.why: Repeating job retries stay invisible until they run out.
